# PsychPlus

> > PsychPlus provides accessible, affordable psychiatric care and mental health treatment through virtual and in-person services nationwide.

PsychPlus is a comprehensive mental healthcare provider offering psychiatric care, therapy, and specialized treatment for various mental health conditions. The platform combines licensed psychiatrists, therapists, and evidence-based treatment modalities including medication management, cognitive behavioral therapy, and advanced therapies like TMS and Spravato.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health Treatment
- Psychiatric Care
- Therapy Services
- ADHD Treatment
- Depression Treatment
- Anxiety Disorders
- PTSD Treatment
- Bipolar Disorder
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
- Virtual Care
- Medication Management
- Sleep Disorders
- Borderline Personality Disorder
- Schizophrenia
- Insurance Coverage

## Getting Started

- [Peace of Mind is a Plus - Book Your Psychiatric Appointment](https://psychplus.com): PsychPlus homepage: book psychiatric appointments, virtual/in-person care
- [Making Mental Health Affordable and Accessible at PsychPlus](https://psychplus.com/our-mission): PsychPlus mission statement on affordable, accessible mental healthcare
- [Visit Us Today - Find PsychPlus Locations Near You](https://psychplus.com/locations): Find PsychPlus clinic locations nationwide and schedule appointments
- [Discover Multiple Treatment Options for Your Mental Health](https://psychplus.com/for-patients): Patient guide to PsychPlus treatment options: therapy, medication, telehealth

- [Borderline Personality Disorder Treatment at PsychPlus](https://psychplus.com/borderline-personality-disorder): BPD treatment at PsychPlus using DBT and cognitive behavioral therapy
- [Schizophrenia Treatment at PsychPlus](https://psychplus.com/schizophrenia): Schizophrenia treatment with therapy and medication management
